chapter: Early influences, Oliver date and trombone peers
title: Meeting Louis Armstrong and joining Luis Russell's band
summary: He met Armstrong while with Luis Russell at the Savoy, and stayed with Armstrong about six years.

story.theme_name: Working with and around Louis Armstrong
story.community_name: Playing with and around Louis Armstrong

blocks.x: When was your first encounter with Louis Armstrong?
When did you first meet him or work with him?
Uh, let's see, where did I first meet him? We were playing, I was playing with Luis Russell's band in Savoy.
Didn't you join Luis Russell's band after Pops was leading the band?

Yeah, that's when I joined the band after ... '37 we were playing in Savoy and Louis Armstrong came from Chicago, you know, like to sit in. OK, excuse me. So when he finished his date and Louis Armstrong closed the engagement in Savoy, we went down to Saratoga Club Montgomery (?) and Louis Armstrong played one night down there with the Broadcasters (?). (indub.) And, ... we were playing at ... and Louis came to New York to get his own band. He came back with Louis Armstrong's band and Lionel Hampton was getting a band together. We were playin' in the Apollo Theatre. And Lionel asked Joe Glycer (?) said, "Who do you want to play with." I're to join him, want to play with Louis." So, that ... I stayed with him, I think, about six years, something like that.
